items.event: China Open, Beijing (Djokovic still in draw)
items.line: Sabalenka (No. 2) lost 6-4, 6-3 to Bartunkova in R3 on Sunday, and Djokovic outlasted Zverev. Quarterfinals are scheduled Oct 8-9, with the tournament running to Oct 11/12.
items.whenJst: Quarterfinals Thu Oct 8 – Fri Oct 9 JST
